strength.label: Strength
strength.note: WHO asks for muscle work on 2+ days a week. We count it as 60 weighted minutes (2 x 30) so longer and harder sessions count for more.

balance.label: Balance & stability
balance.note: WHO asks older adults for balance work on 3+ days a week. We count it as 60 weighted minutes (3 x 20).

mobility.label: Flexibility & mobility
mobility.note: TODO(source): no clinical guideline gives a flexibility target. 60 min/wk (3 x 20) is a placeholder, not a sourced number.
